hypotheses.statement: The CSV writer library change in release 2.1.0 caused the reconciliation job to fail silently without changing exit status
The job failed to produce output due to an issue with the input data for 2026-01-15
The job succeeded but the output file was deleted or moved before Finance checked

observed_facts.statement: Release 2.1.0 was deployed on 2026-01-14 at 17:30:00Z, replacing the CSV writer library
The reconciliation job for 2026-01-15 ran at 02:14:00Z and reported exit status 0 (success)
No alerts fired for the reconciliation job on 2026-01-15
The reconciliation output file for 2026-01-15 is absent from the shared location
Application logs for the 2026-01-15 run are unavailable due to 7-day retention policy
No monitoring or alerts were configured for the reconciliation job
Upstream input data for 2026-01-15 is unavailable due to 7-day retention policy
The reconciliation job for 2026-01-22 ran successfully, processing 412,093 rows and writing output
The 2026-01-15 output was regenerated manually from a downstream copy on 2026-01-23

summary: Reconciliation job for 2026-01-15 reported success (exit status 0) but produced no output file. The failure went undetected for 8 days due to lack of monitoring. A CSV writer library was deployed 9 hours before the failed run. Application logs and input data are unavailable due to 7-day retention policies.
